Exercise: Double Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- hinge
- pull

Primary Muscles:

- hamstrings

Secondary Muscles:

- biceps
- calves
- forearms
- glutes
- lower back
- quadriceps
- traps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC and glycolytic

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- power
- strength

Contraindications:

- Lower back issues
- Shoulder injuries

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Arm Double Kettlebell Hang Clean, equipment: kettlebells
- name: Double Kettlebell Snatch, equipment: kettlebells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Double Kettlebell Alternating Clean from Hang, equipment: kettlebells

Instructions:

- Place two kettlebells between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
- Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell.
- With a fluid motion, lower the top kettlebell while driving the bottom kettlebell up.
